title: Disbursement of HECM Scheduled Monthly Payments
content:
Scheduled payments on a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) are disbursed only on plans that pay fixed monthly scheduled payments, on the plan's scheduled payment day of each month, in the scheduled payment amount on the loan record.

**When a payment is made.** A scheduled payment is disbursed only while the loan status is active. Payments stop for good once the loan is due and payable or in the deferral period, and no payment is made for a month that began before the loan funded. The loan status on the company's record decides; a payment month is never disbursed on a caller's statement about the loan.

**Tenure and term.** A tenure-based plan pays every month while the loan is active. A term-based plan pays only while the term payments made are fewer than the scheduled payment term in months; the term payments made are the scheduled payments of the loan whose payment month lies from the first scheduled payment month up to and including the handling month. After the last term payment the scheduled payments end, and any available line remains drawable only on the Modified Term plan.

**Once per month.** Each payment month is disbursed once. The effective date of a payment is the scheduled payment day of its month, and the payment belongs to that month.

| Situation on the handling date | Payment for the month |
|---|---|
| Loan active, plan pays scheduled payments, month not yet paid | disbursed |
| Loan due and payable or in the deferral period | none, and none thereafter |
| Month began before the loan funded | none |
| Term-based plan whose term payments made equal its term | none; the scheduled payments have ended |
| Month already paid | not paid again |

*Hypothetical:* on a term-based plan with a 24-month term, the 24th payment is disbursed when 23 have been made; once 24 have been made no further payment is disbursed.
